definitions.source_rate: Unique finite source cohort, including drain, per source-second.
definitions.observed_rate: Unique callbacks in fixed interior receipt-time intervals per observation-second.
definitions.sustainability: No capacity claim from source-normalized receipts. Bounded observations must repeat at achieved load; internal queues/credits/wakeups are unavailable unless separately recorded.
definitions.model: m5ops is functional payload transfer, excluding timed DMA payload requests.
definitions.byte_accounting: Body bytes exclude serialization; event bytes are typed serialized sample bytes. Never add stereo pair and eye rows.
definitions.tails: Nearest-rank percentiles; every per-window distribution remains explicit.

limitations: Transient observations, not maximum capacity, sustainable throughput or confidence-based tail nonregression.
Latency summaries include delivered samples only. Read missing receipts and missed releases alongside them.
Receipt-time rates exclude drain and may include delayed warmup samples.
No stepped native cases; two explicit shared free-running SHM references.
Bulk is a single scheduled 8MiB sample per direction in the source window, plus warmup traffic.
The new m5ops payload path uses functional/coherent copying instead of timed DMA payload requests.
READY binary identity is pinned; exact retained-source correspondence remains unverified.
